content.title: Content
content.description: Chunk text content to send to your embedding model.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Header hierarchy metadata, typically keys such as Header 1, Header 2, and Header 3.

chunk_id.title: Chunk ID

overview.title: Chunks
